title: Build a String
story: Strings join with +. Greet people the village way.
goal: Write Greet(name string) string returning Namaste, NAME!
socratic: Which pieces of the text are fixed, and which one changes?
Does Go let you add a string and an int with +?
Print your result with Println to see it.
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Build a String”?
